def transform(grid):
    # Horizontal and vertical 9-lines divide the image into rectangular cells.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 9 for v in row)]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h))]
    r_edges = [-1] + row_bars + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + col_bars + [w]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(r_edges, r_edges[1:]):
        row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(c_edges, c_edges[1:]):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(ra + 1, rb) for c in range(ca + 1, cb))
            row.append(8 if n == 1 else 1)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
